t: A binding arrangement made in advance
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اتَّخَذْتُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةً لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
p: Allāhumma innī-ttakhadhtu ʿindaka ʿahdan lan tukhlifanīh…fa-ayyumā mu'minin ādhaytuhu fa-jʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka.
m: O Allah, I have taken a covenant with You that You will not break: any believer I have harmed, make that a means of nearness to You for him.
